capability: Record current 1.20.1 runtime and central artefacts
procedure: Record Java, Fabric Loader, Fabric API, Immersive Portals, Dimensional Weather, Chunky, Replay Mod, Sodium, Indium and Iris artefact names and hashes; compare against the user-reported inventory
pass_criteria: The copied proof profile has an exact reproducible runtime/mod boundary without relying on inferred versions
failure_evidence: Missing launcher metadata, conflicting duplicate artefact or hash mismatch
fallback: Create a reduced copied profile containing only the minimum central files
notes: iCommon/Multiworld are not part of the selected method.

capability: Conditional 1.21.1 migration research
procedure: Run only after a retained 1.20.1 blocker; research an exact replacement intersection for the failed capability
pass_criteria: A migration comparison exists only when tied to a specific failed requirement
failure_evidence: No exact release, incompatible published requirements or absent primary source
fallback: Remain on the selected 1.20.1 workflow
notes: Not a prerequisite for current production.

capability: Scout and approve the lowest-edit R0 location
stack: Seed/world sources; current frozen 1.20.1 world-generation profile; seed-scouting log
procedure: Shortlist candidate seeds/worlds; inspect ridge, clearing, ravine/descent, seam, portal column, fishing bank, camera corridors and import opportunities; estimate camera-visible edits; approve one source before heavy dressing
pass_criteria: One candidate supports the locked hero shots with documented coordinates, provenance, camera access, missing features and a feasible import/edit plan
failure_evidence: Candidate screenshots/notes, rejected reasons and edit-distance comparison
fallback: Broaden the search or assemble R0 from the strongest candidate plus imported hero geography
notes: A naturally perfect seed is not required; an authored downloadable map requires usage-rights evidence.

capability: Clean profile launch and reload
stack: Copied Minecraft 1.20.1 profile; recorded Java/Fabric; Fabric API; Immersive Portals 5.2.0
procedure: Launch the reduced copied profile, create a test world, register one test dimension, save, exit, reload twice and retain logs/hashes
pass_criteria: Two launches and reloads complete with the test dimension retained and no blocker-level errors
failure_evidence: Crash report, latest log, mod list and exact reproduction steps
fallback: Use static dimension definitions or composite portal route
notes: Minimum bridge stack precedes weather, replay, shaders and cosmetic mods.

capability: R0 duplicate and custom-dimension terrain transfer
stack: POC-001; duplicated R0/R1 test saves; custom dimension; file-copy or MCA Selector workflow
procedure: Create a small R0 test; duplicate it as R1 and add unmistakable block/container changes; register and visit mns:r1_test; close Minecraft; back up the filming test save; replace/import R1 region data at zero offset; reopen and verify twice after reload; test entities and poi only in separate optional passes
pass_criteria: R0 and R1 remain independently editable; terrain, blocks, containers, lighting and coordinates match the intended working save after two reloads; no stale destination chunks survive
failure_evidence: Save copies, folder map, coordinate stills, block/container checks, logs and mismatch measurements
fallback: Use full-folder replacement, controlled MCA import or matched hero-location shells
notes: Multiworld is removed from this proof. Portals are created only after transfer validation.

capability: Pregenerated footprint and custom-dimension boundary safety
stack: Approved R0; Chunky 1.3.146; current frozen world-generation profile
procedure: Map every portal sightline, landscape shot, route and Replay camera; pregenerate the footprint plus buffer before duplication; after transfer, inspect outer camera-visible boundaries and attempt no new production-visible generation
pass_criteria: Every camera-visible chunk exists identically in R0-derived saves and no shot depends on newly generated custom-dimension terrain
failure_evidence: Chunk map, Chunky settings/progress, boundary stills and mismatch list
fallback: Expand/regenerate the R0 footprint and retransfer affected regions
notes: Do not rely on Tectonic/WWOO/Ecologics generating the same unseen chunks under new dimension IDs.

capability: Portal view, parallax and player crossing
procedure: Record static view, four-block lateral move and threshold crossing in both directions; inspect clipping, parallax, load discontinuity and reload
pass_criteria: Destination perspective responds correctly, source foreground occludes correctly and player crossing is editorially usable twice after reload
failure_evidence: Video, transform data, logs and frame-by-frame defect notes
fallback: Matched destination plate, tracked mask and concealed cut
notes: Do not include Moss until terrain transfer and player crossing pass.

capability: Common fixed time with dry R0 and rainy R1
procedure: Set one fixed time; disable cycles; set R0 clear and R1 rain; view R1 from R0, cross, save/reload twice and repeat without shaders
pass_criteria: Rain, destination light, waterfall and state persist while R0 remains dry; time remains editorially consistent; audio can be isolated
failure_evidence: Source/destination stills, weather commands, logs and mismatch notes
fallback: Composite rainy R1 plate and rebuild audio in post
notes: Do not require independent dimension time. Test seasons separately if used for R4.

capability: Asymmetric R4→R0 view with R0→R1 entry
procedure: Create minimal R0, R1 and R4 portals; record every face and entry direction before and after reload
pass_criteria: R4 shows and enters R0 as required while the scripted R0 entry continues to R1, or a documented shot-specific configuration reproduces both states
failure_evidence: Destination table, recordings, commands and unwanted return-mouth evidence
fallback: Shot-specific portal states or composited views
notes: Simultaneous live topology is preferred but not mandatory if editorial continuity remains exact.

capability: Datapack setup-arm-action-reset-cleanup lifecycle
stack: Vanilla functions, tags, markers, scoreboards and structures
procedure: Run one non-destructive take twice, reload, then run again; inspect rules, marks, actors and cleanup selectors
pass_criteria: Each cycle returns to the same armed state; no untagged or persistent entity changes; rules restore on cleanup
failure_evidence: Before/after data, logs and list of leaked entities or state drift
fallback: Add Carpet/Scarpet for the isolated timing gap or use world-state copies
notes: Custom mod is not an initial fallback.

capability: Camera and replay compatibility
stack: Validated transfer/weather stack; Replay Mod 2.6.23 first; alternatives only after a specific failure
procedure: Record one locked shot, one lateral portal path, one actor take and one cross-dimensional event with Replay Mod 2.6.23; save/reload and render/capture; test an alternative only for a failed criterion
pass_criteria: Numerical repeatability, correct portal/interior/entities/weather and playable output without blocker defects
failure_evidence: Logs, replay defects, missing entity list and frame-time comparison
fallback: Vanilla locked camera, spectator path or matched plates
notes: The installed Replay Mod is the first route; do not compare tools merely for completeness.

capability: Stable no-shader capture baseline and optional rendering additions
stack: Validated portal/camera stack; recording tool unselected
procedure: Measure static, lateral and crossing shots without shaders; then add Sodium and Iris individually only from exact pins
pass_criteria: Playable capture at the selected resolution/frame rate with no visible portal corruption and acceptable recorded frame pacing
failure_evidence: Frame-time trace, capture inspection, crash/log evidence and exact settings
fallback: Reduce portal recursion/render distance; remove shaders; composite destination
notes: No target is claimed until hardware and recorder are selected.

capability: Skeleton threat, wild-wolf intervention and taming transition
procedure: Arm skeleton, wild wolf and protagonist on fixed marks; release scheduled plates; perform visible bones offer and inspect state before/after taming
pass_criteria: Threat, intervention and cause-to-taming read clearly; no collar/name appears early; reset repeats
failure_evidence: Path deviations, targeting evidence, state screenshots and reset defects
fallback: Separate skeleton, wolf response and taming plates
notes: Do not rely on natural targeting RNG.

capability: Fishing-to-name-tag and anvil MOSS chain
stack: tpnm_take; vanilla fishing/anvil; controlled inventory insert
procedure: Stage a fishing action and readable acquisition/pick-up insert; show anvil label `MOSS`; apply to correct tamed unnamed wolf
pass_criteria: Edit preserves fishing as cause and the name appears only after application
failure_evidence: Unreadable catch, early name, wrong wolf state or inventory mismatch
fallback: Controlled catch/pick-up insert joined to genuine fishing action
notes: This is a scheduling control, not a claim about catch probability.

capability: Moss states, routines and portal crossing
procedure: Test wild, tamed-unnamed and named states; follow, wait, sit, second sit gesture, feed and crossing; reload and inspect owner/name/collar/health/pose
pass_criteria: Every required state and short action is repeatable; named Moss crosses and retains data after reload
failure_evidence: Entity data, screenshots, path logs and duplication/loss evidence
fallback: Destination-side Moss plate with concealed handoff; shorter controlled actions
notes: Persistent Moss cannot be silently replaced.

capability: Rug-origin fire path and progressive reset
procedure: Run repeated fire mechanics tests from the defined final green square with timing recorded; restore from pre-fire state after each run
pass_criteria: Origin and route are legible and at least one method produces a controllable rug-to-timber fan without contaminating the master
failure_evidence: Before/after states, tick timings, spread variance and restore verification
fallback: Progressive art-directed states retaining tested origin and burn fan
notes: Natural RNG is not a production dependency.

capability: Connected creeper ledge, peripheral plant, fall and hiss timing
stack: Sacrificial final chamber; tpnm_take; Carpet conditional
procedure: Verify physical ledge-to-landing route; capture sub-second edge at delivery size; repeat fall/landing/hiss with exact marks
pass_criteria: Route is discoverable on rewatch, unobtrusive first time and lands behind the protagonist at the required cue
failure_evidence: Route diagram, failed paths, timing and review notes
fallback: Separate glimpse, fall, landing, hiss and reaction plates
notes: No sting or protagonist reaction in Scene 11.

capability: Fatal blast and readable aftermath geometry
procedure: Test difficulty, equipment, distance, frame/baffle damage and item scatter; never use the only set state
pass_criteria: Blast can motivate death and an aftermath plate can retain recognisable frame/baffle geography without forbidden items
failure_evidence: Damage values, geometry comparisons, item list and restore proof
fallback: Black-frame fatal cut and art-directed protagonist-free aftermath
notes: No claim that the frame naturally survives as scripted.

capability: Portal failure and quiet R4 collapse
procedure: Create stable, contracting and inert states; review the R3 forced exit and R4 soft fade with sound layers
pass_criteria: State change is readable, non-explosive and does not resemble ordinary Nether behaviour
failure_evidence: Review export and notes on clipping, timing or confusion
fallback: Matched plates with animated mask and projected-block fade
notes: Portal exposition stays within Script labels.

capability: Delayed anchor flash, particles and R0 view
procedure: Assemble black interval, smoke, one violet flash, first particle, second particle and gradual destination view in Script order
pass_criteria: Viewers read delayed activation after death and do not infer a vanilla mechanic or survival
failure_evidence: Timing export, comprehension notes and continuity defects
fallback: Simpler locked dissolve into the active frame
notes: No narration follows death.

capability: Smoke, fire, water and steam continuity
procedure: Compare distant smoke, path fire light, doorway water, steam, falling timber and breached-room plate across locked cameras
pass_criteria: Effects preserve geography and do not obscure the empty-place/burn-fan evidence
failure_evidence: Layer breakdown and continuity overlay
fallback: Reduce live effects and use isolated layers
notes: Avoid resolving Moss through background debris or sound.

capability: MATCH PATH and MATCH FRAME A repeatability
stack: Protected R0/R4 states; chosen camera tool
procedure: Record numerical transforms, FOV, lighting, marks and reference overlays; repeat each after reload
pass_criteria: Path frames align within the approved overlay tolerance and MF-A uses identical picture design and one narration asset
failure_evidence: Overlay difference images, transform records and state mismatch list
fallback: Reuse source plate or rebuild dressing around one locked camera
notes: Tolerance must be set by human review after greyboxing.

capability: Frame-foot and granite-seam continuity
procedure: Capture seam and left-foot reference from every echo; overlay silhouette and marker positions
pass_criteria: Natural seam remains recognisable and marker presence/absence is unambiguous
failure_evidence: Overlay and mismatch notes
fallback: Matched hero shell or corrective rebuild
notes: Do not repair with colour grading alone.

capability: Final-frame asymmetry and creeper route geography
stack: R0 receiving mouth; R4 source chamber
procedure: Compare frame dimensions/asymmetries and trace ledge to landing in plan/elevation
pass_criteria: R4 source visually matches R0 mouth and ledge connection is physically readable
failure_evidence: Measurements, overlays and route recording
fallback: Shot-specific matched shell and separate fall plate
notes: Story topology is fictional; physical visual match is required.

capability: Homestead milestone continuity
procedure: Review shelter, home, rug stages, pre-fire, burning and burned states against a prop/state checklist
pass_criteria: Each later state follows visibly from the previous one and destructive states restore from verified sources
failure_evidence: State checklist, restore hashes or copy identifiers and discrepancies
fallback: Rebuild only the affected module from the protected milestone
notes: No completed world state exists.

capability: Narration/bark reuse and portal-audio boundaries
stack: Isolated audio stems; recorder/edit system unselected
procedure: Place one mining-departure recording in Scenes 2 and 13; reuse one Scene 9 bark in Scene 12; review Scenes 2–3 and 13 for surface portal sound
pass_criteria: Audio assets are byte-identical where required; no surface hum; remembered bark reads as subjective
failure_evidence: Waveform/file comparison and full-sequence mix notes
fallback: Replace both placements from one approved master and rebuild stems
notes: No audio recording exists.

capability: Journal, Atlas, ledger, title and name readability
procedure: Create only Script-approved pages, hold at planned FOV/duration and review at delivery size without narration
pass_criteria: Required symbols, markers and seven Atlas instructions are legible in order with no superseded wording
failure_evidence: Still/motion review and list of misread labels
fallback: Larger, fewer or longer locked inserts
notes: No graphic asset exists.

capability: Scene 13 omniscient reading and loop clarity
procedure: Show protagonist-free aftermath, external frame approach, environmental ascent and MF-A repeat to reviewers without explanatory additions
pass_criteria: Reviewers understand the protagonist died, camera is audience access and R0 entry will continue to R1
failure_evidence: Anonymous comprehension responses and confusion notes
fallback: Shorten to explicit environmental dissolves and an external establishing plate
notes: Do not add narration after death.

capability: Moss fate remains unresolved
procedure: Inspect every picture and sound for body, collar drop, death text, locating bark, implication of escape or final-R0 survival proof
pass_criteria: Review confirms only absence in R4 and earlier Moss in R0
failure_evidence: Timestamped list of offending evidence
fallback: Remove or replace affected plate, item or sound
notes: This is a canon gate.

capability: Five-panel storyboard model consistency
stack: Real Minecraft/Blender greyboxes; ChatGPT Images 2.0 and FLUX.2 Pro comparison
procedure: Transform the five approved reference cases into one graphite-and-ink style; overlay outputs and score identity, geometry, props, ratio and continuity
pass_criteria: All five preserve essential composition and canon without invented evidence; human approves one model
failure_evidence: Prompts, source frames, overlays and failure notes
fallback: Retain text/greybox boards or test alternative model
notes: No image may be generated until the human triggers the later test.
